H08-01: Inspection of CSS animations and motion transitions for reduced-motion alternatives.
Pass: No motion CSS is found or prefers-reduced-motion support is implemented.
Fail: Motion effects (animations/transforms) exist without a reduced-motion fallback.
1. Extract CSS rules and inline styles. Detect animation properties.
2. Detect transition properties specifically acting on motion/layout (transform, translate, width, etc.).
3. Check HTML for @media (prefers-reduced-motion) or Tailwind motion-reduce.
If animations or motion transitions lack a prefers-reduced-motion fallback:
- Implement @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) to disable or minimize animations for users with motion sensitivity settings enabled.
